svg.title: Conservation Officer Service — blue shoulder edition
svg.desc: Reconstruction with supplied native vector insignia. User-supplied native insignia paths and colours are retained. Shoulders use the crown/wreath/shield/dogwood portion with the lower ribbon and side folds excluded by a fixed vector window; cap/breast uses the complete native ribbon edition. Source photographs retain their own cloth cuts and captions. Exact embroidery edges, thread colours, original typeface and the uploaded artwork’s manufacturing provenance are not authenticated.
